annotations.text:
Current build. Each .ctl-row is one non-wrapping flex line inside a 340px panel.
FREE is clipped off VIEW; HOWITZER and BOX RIG are clipped off SUBJECT — two vehicles you cannot select at all.

The fix. The buttons move into their own wrapping group; the 54px label column stays fixed and top-aligns.
Rows grow downward instead of running off the edge, so a seventh or eighth subject costs a line, never a button.

Phone. Same wrap — every subject reachable — and the sheet capped at 44dvh (was 56dvh/460px) so the drawing keeps the upper half.
SUBJECT is promoted to the top of the sheet: the sheet scrolls, so the row you reach for goes above the pose sliders. VIEW stays in the bar, where it already was.
